DocumentServiceCopyDocumentBody.description:
CopyDocument creates a new document row in the target folder pointing
at the same content_blob as the source's current version. Shallow:
only the current version is brought over; versions / share-links /
comments / annotations / OCR stay with the original.

hwError.description: Standard error envelope. `type` is a stable machine code (e.g. IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED, VALIDATION, FORBIDDEN).

blob_checksum.description: sha256 hex of the already-uploaded blob.

content_blob_id.description: Alias for blob_ref (the value complete returns).

folder_id.description: Where a NEW document lands if the read has no match.

target_customer_ref.description: Caller routing hint; part of the ingest idempotency key.

sha256_hash.description: Optional; enables dedup at initiate + verification at complete.

external_key.description: Optional for new_document (defaults to the extracted key).

ocr_text.description: Populated only on the single-item GET.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor; empty when there are no more pages.

external_id.description: Caller-owned stable business key, tenant-unique (e.g. INV-2024-00188).

created.description: true = a brand-new document was minted.

blob_checksum.description: sha256 hex of the already-uploaded blob; the no-op comparison key.

blob_ref.description: Optional content_blob id; verified against blob_checksum.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

plaintext.title: returned ONLY on issue; never stored

contentBlobId.description:
Optional: if the bytes have already been uploaded via the regular
storage upload flow, supply the resulting content_blob_id and the
bulk import will create a Version pointing at it. If omitted the
document is created in DRAFT state with no content.

internalId.title: UUID assigned (same as map lookup on retry)

scanResult.title: PENDING if async scan pipeline not done

externalId.description: Optional caller-owned stable business key. Tenant-unique when set.

createdByName.description:
Denormalised uploader display name. Filled at read time by a
LEFT JOIN against the users table in the document repository.
Empty when the uploader row is missing; frontend uses that as
the signal to render "Deleted user". Soft-deleted users still
carry their display_name on the row so attribution survives
account deletion.

externalId.description:
Caller-owned stable business key (e.g. "INV-2024-00188"). Tenant-
unique when set; empty when the document has no external mapping.
Set on create + upsert; surfaced on reads. See the documents:upsert
and documents:byExternalKey REST routes.

workflowInstance.description:
Active workflow summary, filled at read time by a LEFT JOIN
LATERAL against workflow_instances (status NOT IN ('completed',
'failed','cancelled')). Absent when the document has no in-
flight workflow. Frontend renders a status pill on the document
card + header.

type.title: PERSON | ORG | DATE | MONEY | EMAIL | PHONE | CUSTOM

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; empty when there are no more children.

v1PageRequest.title: ---- Legacy pagination (kept for Phase C services) ------------------------

tenantId.title: admin override; normal users scoped to own tenant

memberCount.description:
member_count — workspace_members rows for this workspace. Powers
the "N members" pill on workspace cards. Includes admins, members,
and viewers; folder-grant-only callers are not counted.

info.description: Multi-tenant enterprise Document Management System. Proto-generated gateway routes plus the hand-wired HTTP surface (see the hand-wired tags + INTEGRATION.md for the ERP integration contracts).
info.title: SeDoc API

IdempotencyKey.description: Replay-safety key (tenant-scoped). REQUIRED on resource-creating POSTs for API-key callers; optional for session callers. A retry with the same key replays the original response (Idempotency-Replayed: true) and creates nothing new. See INTEGRATION.md §Idempotency.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Request body is newline-delimited JSON: an optional first envelope line {request_id, batch_size}, then one item line per resource ({resource: "document", document: {...}}). Documents are processed through a bounded worker pool and are idempotent on external_id (re-runs dedupe; duplicates within a batch converge). Responds with an NDJSON stream of per-item results.

get.summary: Stream the decrypted bytes of an envelope-encrypted version

200.description: Blob bytes or a presigned URL.

302.description: Redirect to a presigned S3 URL (plaintext blobs).

get.summary: Download a specific version (presigned redirect for plaintext blobs)

get.description: Streams the decrypted bytes of the document's current version.
Permission-filtered: returns 404 when the key is unknown OR the caller may not view it (existence is not leaked).
get.summary: Resolve internal ids from a business key

post.description: Stages an already-uploaded blob as an ingestion_item WITHOUT creating a document/version, and emits dms.ingestion.received.v1. The intelligence worker OCRs + extracts a business key against the blob, then a Temporal workflow auto-commits a high-confidence read (new version of a match, or a new document) or routes a low-confidence read to the review queue. Idempotent on (tenant, blob_checksum, target_customer_ref).
post.summary: Stage a completed blob for OCR-then-route

parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous page's next_cursor.
parameters.name: cursor

get.summary: Get one review item with OCR text

post.description: decision = new_version (append the staged blob as a new version of target_document_id) | new_document (file standalone) | reject (discard, no version). Emits dms.review.resolved.v1. Resolving an already-resolved item returns 409.

Step 1 of the upload flow. Returns a presigned S3 URL the client PUTs the bytes to directly, plus the upload_id used to complete. When sha256_hash is supplied and a matching blob already exists, the response is deduplicated (no PUT needed).
post.summary: Begin an upload — get a presigned PUT URL

post.description: Step 3 of the upload flow (after the client PUTs the bytes). Verifies the checksum, virus-scans, envelope-encrypts, and persists the content_blob. Returns content_blob_id — use it (or the checksum) as blob_ref in :upsert / CreateVersion / /ingest.
post.summary: Finalize an upload (scan, encrypt, persist blob)

parameters.description:
Keyset pagination (Workstream 6 — folder hierarchy at 100k). page_size
defaults to 50 and is capped at 200 server-side. page_token is an opaque
cursor returned as next_page_token from the previous page; empty = first page.
parameters.name: pageSize

post.description: Idempotent on (tenant, external_id): no existing doc → create + v1; existing + same checksum → no-op; existing + new checksum → append a version. Blob bytes must already be uploaded via the storage flow (referenced by blob_checksum / blob_ref). Returns 201 when a new document is minted, 200 otherwise.

409.description: Idempotency-Key in progress, OR external_id maps to a trashed document.

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused for a different request.

ApiKeyBearer.description: ERP / service-to-service auth. Send `Authorization: Bearer vdms_<key>`. The key carries scopes (documents:read, documents:write, upload); each route below names the scope it requires. The browser uses the dms_session cookie instead — the same routes accept either.
ApiKeyBearer.name: Authorization
